- Frontend hook — `useMemos` / `useInfiniteMemos` in `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` (calls `memoServiceClient.listMemos(...)`)
- Client file — `web/src/connect.ts` (`memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport)`, a Connect-RPC client)
- Proto RPC — `rpc ListMemos(ListMemosRequest) returns (ListMemosResponse)` in `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (maps to `GET /api/v1/memos`)
- Backend handler — `func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemos(...)` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`
- Store method — `func (s *Store) ListMemos(...)` in `store/memo.go` (delegates to `s.driver.ListMemos(ctx, find)`, whose interface is declared in `store/driver.go`)
- Dialect implementation — `func (d *DB) ListMemos(...)` in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (equivalents also exist in `store/db/postgres/memo.go` and `store/db/mysql/memo.go`)
